name: Ninisanni Scenario 2: The Harem End
source:
One year has passed since the events of Ninisanni Scenario 1, and MC-kun is depressed... again. But this time it's for totally non-trivial reasons! Despite securing a harem of nine lovely ladies, he has some (cowardly) latent guilt stemming from the fact that his "harem" is just him sleeping with nine girls simultaneously without them knowing about each other.
But that's peanuts compared to the big bad news... Pomu is gone! And we don't know where she went! She didn't even send a postcard! And you know she's the type to send postcards!!

But despite all the spooky mystery and intrigue, really, most of the time is just the troublesome goofs hanging out and causing trouble. What better way to spend a summer?
translation:
距离尼尼萨尼剧情1的事件已经过去了一年，MC君又陷入了沮丧……。但这一次的原因绝对不简单！尽管拥有九个可爱的女士的后宫，他还是有一些（胆怯的）潜在的负罪感，因为他的“后宫”只是他同时和九个女孩睡觉，而她们彼此都不知道。
但与大坏消息相比，这只是微不足道的事情……Pomu不见了！而且我们不知道她去了哪里！她连明信片都没寄！你知道她是那种会寄明信片的人！

但尽管有所有令人毛骨悚然的神秘和阴谋，实际上，大多数时候只是一些麻烦的傻瓜在闲逛并制造麻烦。还有什么更好的方式度过夏天呢？
